note: The strongest published solvers per problem class, with when their results were published. 'leading' marks the ones a study claiming to beat the state of the art must include (or explicitly defer). Sources are the Evaluations' own rankings. 'solver_key' is the solver's key in the candidate kinds (maxsat-anytime-v1, maxsat-anytime-2026-v1); a study includes a solver when its summary's 'champions' records that key (with the pinned binary's SHA-256). 'as_of' is when the catalog was last checked against the field and 'refresh' when the field next publishes results; after that date the cell's autoreceptor reports STALE_KNOWLEDGE until the catalog is checked again.

unweighted_partial_maxsat_anytime.source: MaxSAT Evaluation 2024 talk (Berg, Jarvisalo); MaxSAT Evaluation 2026 slides and results.zip (Zenodo 21358014); ECAI 2025 (DeepDist); SOFT 2026 (Aperture)

refresh.event: MaxSAT Evaluation results, presented each summer at the SAT conference (checked from 1 July, before they are announced, so the cell never runs on a stale catalog)
